name: Pa'lowick
description: Pa'lowicks were a sentient species of long-limbed reptilian humanoids that had spotted skin, eyes that protruded from the tops of their heads, and trunk-like mouths. Sy Snootles, the lead singer of the Max Rebo Band, was a Pa'lowick.

data.name: Pa'lowick
data.skincolor: Yellow, with blue or purple spots
data.distinctions: Long limbs, protruding eyes, spotted skin, trunk-like mouths
